what_the_ruling_decided.verdict: `collision: partial` ACCEPTED as the audit read it: none on the coset-shifted EQS4 headline arm, partial on the EQS2 control arm, which two prior instruments have scanned under a fall-to-linear criterion without Koszul exclusion.
what_the_ruling_decided.proceed: YES. TASK-20260916-0c2802 moves from `blocked` to `queued`. Nothing found contradicts H-SEMBIN-a7e721 and stopping on this evidence would be unjustified steering.
what_the_ruling_decided.reuse: Read any candidate; import none into the measurement path; macaulay.rank_mod_p at p = 2 is promoted to a TEST ORACLE inside the C-3 fixture suite. Amendment A-1.
what_the_ruling_decided.reframings: R-1 adopted and made binding as A-3 (the unshifted arm reports as a replication with a changed instrument, with the four differences stated). R-2 declined as a fixture, with three reasons and a revisit condition, and adopted instead as A-3's post-hoc comparison.
what_the_ruling_decided.new_requirements: A-2 one builder for both arms with the control at v = 0; A-4 the GF(2) rank kernel is checked against an independent computation and known-rank matrices before any Nagao instance, inheriting SR-3's stop.
what_the_ruling_decided.audit_discharged: proof_search_map.observation_collision_search, which read REQUIRED BEFORE THE FIRST RUN and not yet performed, is now performed. Its RECALL remains a floor: the kb index could not be called.

the_finding_worth_more_than_the_verdict: The audit established by reading the code that this program cannot BUILD a shifted instance: src/semaev_tree.py has no coset, shift, v_i or offset anywhere and make_V_subspace returns a subspace through the origin, so every Semaev descent the program has made is v = 0, which is EQS2 in Nagao's Definition 4. The Coordinator confirmed both independently. It cuts both ways -- the headline arm's novelty rests on a checkable absence in code rather than on a failed search, and the shifted construction is new implementation work with no precedent in the tree.

one_audit_finding_corrected.what_the_audit_said: That macaulay.rank_mod_p's Fermat inverse pow(x, p-2, p) degenerates at p = 2 and the routine would need specialising.
one_audit_finding_corrected.what_is_true: It is correct at p = 2 with no specialisation: the only invertible residue mod 2 is 1 and pow(1, 0, 2) = 1. Checked against an independently written bitset eliminator on 300 random 0/1 matrices up to 9x9; agreement on every one.
one_audit_finding_corrected.effect: Changes the ruling's REASONS, not its outcome. The correctness objection is withdrawn, which is why the routine becomes a test oracle rather than merely a reference; it stays out of the measurement path on coupling and performance grounds.
one_audit_finding_corrected.this_is_not_a_run: A rank routine sanity check is not a measurement of any quantity this contract defines and discharges no metric or criterion.

defect_found_while_writing_this_and_NOT_.what: The cbb416 review plan declares its joints as `id`/`name`/`owner` where templates/research-records.md and tools/check_review_independence.py both use `joint`/`assigned_to`. The checker therefore cannot see the plan's ownership at all, and would report every joint as unowned once attestations exist -- so both reviewer cards' completion gate (`check_review_independence.py raises no problem`) is currently unpassable as written. review-plan-addendum-1.yaml's reassignment is inert for the same reason: the composer matches on `joint` labels it cannot find.
defect_found_while_writing_this_and_NOT_.why_it_is_not_fixed_in_this_commit: It is outside this task's declared write scope, it is not this ruling's subject, and an archive commit must change exactly its declared set. Mixing a tools/ repair into a ledger archive is how an archive stops being verifiable.
defect_found_while_writing_this_and_NOT_.when_it_bites: Only when the first reviewer attests, which cannot happen until TASK-20260916-0c2802 has run and been snapshotted. Found before the round rather than during it, which is the whole reason to render the gates early.
defect_found_while_writing_this_and_NOT_.recorded_as: The Coordinator's next action after dispatching the executor, and it will carry its own correction record. Not a defect in the audit and not a defect in the other session's addendum, which is correct as written against the plan it extends.
